terms: host: a server or device the user connects to, not a person hosting something
credential: saved login details such as a password or SSH key
key: usually an SSH or API key, not a keyboard key unless the text is about shortcuts
snippet: a saved shell command the user can run
plugin: an add-on that extends Termix
jump host: an intermediate SSH server used to reach another host
folder: a group of hosts in the sidebar
split view: showing several tabs side by side
